sharedReferences.role: Pixel-art cluster size and edge definition, supplied as a PNG copy.
Dry ochre soil and trench palette.

preparation: Copy each generated PNG into this directory without resampling and run python -B scripts/webp-backgrounds.py.

views.prompt:
Use case: precise art-direction redraw of the supplied 2D game background. Image 1 is the exact existing 3:2 stage artwork and technical layout; honor pixel positions, same frame and field of view. Image 2 is this game's German soldier sprite atlas, for intentional crisp contiguous pixel clusters and compact shading only. Image 3 is the palette and material cue for the in-game earth trench. Do not put the soldier or the trench art into the background.
Keep this exact lookout on the grassy slope, open playable terrain and original skyline. The river is a small blue-green accent between distant slate ridges. Cool quiet foreground greens only as occasional gray-olive straw shadows, predominantly muted gray ochre. Keep broad uninterrupted horizontal bands of gently sloping ground through the upper and center field where units go.
Art direction: an authored and restrained 16-bit pixel-art WWII game terrain plate in Jablanica, late winter. Render the composition with larger deliberate two-to-six-pixel clusters, decisive grouped terrain shapes, and about five shades per material, with no texture noise, no lone stipple pixels, no continuous gradients and no brushy filtered edges. Cool slate and limestone grays in the cliffs, subdued slate-blue distance, rich but quiet dark teal river, gray-ochre dry earth and straw, with small warmer foreground accents. Clear atmospheric perspective and peaceful unbroken patches under the enemy rows. Strongest edges on key rock planes and the bridge landmark, never an all-over black outline. Flat matte color and moderate contrast so the separately overlaid soldiers read clearly. Simplify the sky to clean overcast bands without individual clouds and keep the river still, with no painted foam streaks. No new paths, no foreground set dressing, no units, no text, no borders, no mist that obscures the playing field. Keep full landscape 1536 by 1024 aspect, fit all the original landmarks in the same positions. This is a literal redrawing preserving layout, with a clearly visible new pixel art style.
